name: BBQ Ranch Ground Turkey Veggie Skillet
ingredients_verbatim: 1 Tbsp. coconut oil or cooking fat
1 large (~16 oz.) sweet potato, cubed 1/2 inch
2 cups (~10 oz.) Brussels sprouts, halved or quartered
1 medium zucchini, sliced into half moons
2 cups (~8 oz.) baby bella mushrooms, sliced
Optional toppings: avocado, cilantro, lime, green onion, shredded cheese, crushed blue corn chips
method_line: Brown turkey; saute sweet potato, then Brussels sprouts, then zucchini/mushrooms/onion; fold turkey back in with BBQ-ranch sauce and cook to combine (one skillet, stovetop).
board_mapping_note: All main ingredients map to the Omaha board: ground-turkey, coconut-oil, sweet-potatoes, brussels-sprouts, zucchini, mushrooms, onions, garlic, bbq-sauce, ranch-dressing, raisins. Tessemae's branded BBQ/Ranch collapse to generic bbq-sauce + ranch-dressing.
why: Verified from the source nutrition card: 415 cal / 31g carb / 23g protein per serving, inside the 400-650 cal and <=35g carb band. Ground turkey, one-skillet stovetop, no seafood, weigh-and-divide scalable to 14. HONEST CONFIDENCE: LOW-MODERATE for surviving our own gate. It sits at BOTH band edges (cal near the 400 floor, carbs near the 35 ceiling), and the carbs come from a starchy base (sweet potato + optional golden raisins + BBQ sauce sugar) rather than the catalog's meat+fat+non-starchy-veg identity, so our label-accurate recompute could tip carbs past 35 or cal below 400. Recommend dropping the optional raisins if selected to protect the carb gate. Protein 23g is just under the 25g high-protein identity. Included because it is the only ground-turkey skillet I could VERIFY inside the band this pass (see summary).
